originality.rationale: Targeted research-record searches and available prior records did not recover the same theorem. Direct inspection of the 2022 source found OA order-parameter ODE and one-point stationary densities but not its stationary two-time law. The 2018 reset-spectrum principle shifts existing dynamical modes; it does not give the nonlinear Kuramoto spectral measure, its positive density, or the square-root threshold coefficient. The 2021 resetting autocorrelation work concerns Brownian diffusion, and the 2018 Kuramoto autocorrelation work concerns Gaussian white-noise forcing. The 2024 subsystem-resetting setting is dynamically different. The evaluated contribution is the exact three-regime covariance classification, critical positive spectral density and sharp coefficient—not any known flow, reset-age identity, or generic shifted spectrum. Broader unlocated renewal/spectral work remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: The previously established one-time synchronization phase diagram leaves the decay of stationary order-parameter fluctuations undetermined. A universal three-regime rate classification, strictly positive amplitudes, and the square-root critical spectral edge with exact coefficient give a meaningful dynamical phase-transition signature and reveal a centering-induced t^-3/2 versus t^-1/2 exponent shift. This is not a mere parameter substitution or a numerical curiosity.
